name: Frank
description: A stitched-together gentle giant of indeterminate age who sings slow sentimental ballads with total sincerity; the roster's tallest figure.
build: Very tall, heavy-shouldered and long-armed with large square hands and a stiff, deliberate, upright bearing; never hunched, shambling, lurching or menacing.
face: A tall flat-topped rectangular head with a heavy brow ridge, grey-green skin, a neat stitched seam across the forehead, and a hopeful, earnest expression. A matching seam circles the character-left wrist and two small metal electrode studs sit on the sides of the neck. The seams are clean dark stitch lines, never wounds.
hair: Short blunt black hair cut straight across the forehead.
outfit: A worn charcoal suit coat one size too small, its sleeves ending short of the wrists, over a dull olive shirt buttoned to the collar, dark trousers ending above the ankles, and very heavy black boots with thick raised soles. No hat or headwear.
personality: Gentle and sincere; earnest rather than imposing.
performance_style: Tall and square: feet planted a little apart, knees nearly straight, shoulders level, and the free character-left hand held open and slightly away from the body.
recognition_cues: a tall flat-topped rectangular head with a heavy brow ridge
short blunt black hair cut straight across the forehead
a neat stitched seam across the forehead and one around the character-left wrist
two small metal electrode studs on the sides of the neck
a too-short dark coat with sleeves ending above the wrists
avoid: blood, gore, open wounds, exposed bone or surgical detail
arms stretched straight out in front in a zombie walk
a hunched, shambling or lurching posture
any real actor's likeness or any film's makeup design

dance.intent: Stiff, earnest dance loop: rock the weight from one heavy boot to the other in a careful two-step, let the free character-left arm swing in a stiff wide arc with the short coat sleeve riding up, then return to the tall square opening stance. Wholesome and a little clumsy, never a lurch.

sing.intent: Heartfelt ballad vocal loop: lift the flat-topped head slightly, press the free character-left hand to the chest, then settle back into his square ready stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound startle: the tall shoulders jerk up and the heavy brow lifts in surprise, the free hand opens wide, then he carefully resettles into his tall square stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn one broad shoulder forward and raise the large free character-left hand as an open shield in front of the face, then hold a steady upright finish. Not a combat action.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: walk in with slow, heavy, deliberate steps, stop, straighten the too-small coat with the free hand, give the room a hopeful little wave, then take the tall square ready stance.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish celebration: raise the free hand overhead in delighted disbelief, the whole tall frame lifting onto the balls of the heavy boots, then settle into a proud, beaming upright pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: he stays on his feet while the hope drains out of him — the heavy shoulders drop, the long arms hang, and his flat-topped head tips low with the chin toward the buttoned collar. He holds a standing, visibly dejected finish with weight even over both heavy boots. He remains standing in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, toppling or going to the ground. Do not imply a hit, injury or opponent.
